messages:
kevin: spun up the new 'hybrid-14b-v2' candidates on staging, ran a quick multiworkload pass. posting raw takeaways so we can decide routing/profile defaults.

anika: awesome — curious about both token econ and qual deltas. can you paste the run command and numbers?

kevin: run command:```
bench run --model hybrid-14b-v2 --modes int8,fp16 --suite multitask --batch 8 --seq 1024 --samples 5k
```

bench-bot: results (summary):
- int8: 1.8M tokens/s across 8 gpus, p95 latency 210ms, est cost $0.008 per 1k tokens, relative qual delta vs prod-13b: -1.9% composite score, hallucination +0.6%
- fp16: 0.6M tokens/s, p95 350ms, est cost $0.028 per 1k tokens, relative qual delta vs prod-13b: +0.3% composite score, hallucination -0.1%

marta: fwiw the int8 run had more variance on long-context summarization. we saw a few truncation-ish artifacts on the 8k tests.

li: quick econ calc: switching endpoint from fp16 to int8 => ~3.5x token cost reduction. if you look at product traffic mix (60% short chat, 30% document-summarize, 10% policy) the blended token cost drops ~45% but composite quality drops ~1.2%.

anika: for GTN recommendation framing: we should map endpoint intents to profiles (latency-sensitive, quality-sensitive, balanced). propose defaults:
- latency-sensitive (chat): hybrid-int8 with aggressive batching + prefix cache.
- quality-sensitive (policy/legal): fp16 with doc-preserving flags.
- balanced (search/assist): fp16 canary 20% then move to int8 if no regression in eval suite.

kevin: agree. also flagging that for the summarize-long-docs flow we should keep fp16 regardless. int8 is fine for Q&A and chit-chat.

marta: can we add a small eval set for the summarize-long-docs checks and gate on a <0.5% quality regression?

li: I'll produce a mini scorecard by tomorrow: metrics = composite_acc, rouge-L, hallucination-rate, latency_p95, cost_per_1k. will include deterministic thresholds per profile.

anika: perfect — also add an explicit rollback policy: if user-facing error rate increases >0.2pp or hallucination >0.5pp on canary, auto-disable int8 route.

kevin: noted. action items: 1) li -> scorecard JSON + threshold (due 24h). 2) marta -> add summarize-long-docs eval set (due 48h). 3) anika -> draft GTN guidance mapping and rollout template.

bench-bot: created artifact: https://benchdash.internal/runs/1823456789 (contains full per-task breakdown). :rocket:

marta: thanks — will start a canary tomorrow morning and update this thread with perf traces. :thumbsup:

kevin: if anyone wants the raw logs ping me, I'll attach. otherwise let's aim to finalize routing defaults by EOD Friday.

anika: sg. tagging @product for awareness when we publish guidance.

li: uploading initial scorecard now.

bench-bot: scorecard artifact: https://benchdash.internal/scorecards/1823456789-int8-vs-fp16.json

kevin: excellent. closing loop once canary completes.
